messages:
Anna (AE): Heads up — Halcyon Financial just asked for an exec-level signoff window. CFO wants a short board Q&A tomorrow 9:00am PT. They need clarity on: pricing floor / discount scenarios, BYOK/KMS attestation, SSO & SCIM, and a throughput SLA for the pilot. Can we get a short internal bridge to pull the docs and a one-pager? @Matt (SE) @Lara (Security) @Micah (Legal)

Matt (SE): On it. I can prep a 1-pager + cost scenarios. Quick Q: what steady-state RPS / tokens/sec are they expecting for the demo?

Anna (AE): They estimated ~200 concurrent sessions, ~1k tokens/session peak on chat flows — rough calc: ~200k tokens/minute at peak.

Lara (Security): Need to know data classification first. If PHI/PII in scope we escalate SOC2 + DLP review. For BYOK we need the KMS key wrapping flow, rotate/rotation policy, and proof of HSM-backed keys if they ask. Also: runbook for audit logs and retention.

Matt (SE): Noted. I can produce the BYOK flow doc and a quick VPC peering snippet. Example for infra team:
```
# enable vpc peering for halcyon-demo
redwood infra create-peering --project halcyon-demo --cidr 10.40.0.0/16
# allocate trial dedicated capacity
redwood capacity reserve --type dedicated --gpus 2 --region us-west-2 --duration 72h
```
I'll include the expected latency delta numbers.

Jordan (Eng): For 200k tokens/minute peak we should recommend a small Dedicated pool. Rough numbers: 2 x A100 can sustain ~250k tokens/min for chat models with 8k context if we enable batching + KV caching. Fallback plan: route to smaller 3B quantized variant if Dedicated is constrained — keeps latency within SLO.

Anna (AE): Great — can you draft two options: (A) hosted + reservation credit (lower commitment) (B) dedicated trial + SLA (higher cost, guaranteed throughput). Sophie, can you add the exec summary slide?

Sophie (CS): Yep — will assemble a 1-slide exec summary and 1-pager for infra. For pricing: what are the floor numbers we can offer for a 3-month pilot vs annual commit? Need ranges to present to the CFO.

Micah (Legal): For BYOK and KMS clauses we can reuse our standard BYOK addendum but need to check egress & indemnity language for cryptography export controls. Also need to see their DPA redlines. Timeline: legal can deliver initial redlines in 48 hours once I have the SOC2 kit + DPA draft.

Anna (AE): Halcyon asked for the SOC2 sysdesc and a DPA this afternoon if possible. Matt — can you attach the SOC2 pointer and the BYOK flow before EOD? Lara — any quick blockers we should flag to the customer?

Lara (Security): If data is considered regulated, we need explicit network isolation (Dedicated) and key custody + audit logs. Otherwise hosted + envelope encryption is fine. Flag: BYOK onboarding needs 24–48h ops time for attestation.

Matt (SE): Will attach SOC2 pointer and BYOK diagram now. Also prepping cost scenarios and a short runbook for the 9am PT call.

ops-bot: capacity-check: Available pools in us-west-2 -> A100: 4 free, V100: 0. Reserved soonest slot: +2 A100 for 12h. (runbook-id: cb-1799990001)

Jordan (Eng): Ops-bot confirms capacity. I'll create a canary policy: route 20% to hosted fallback under load. That gives us safety for the demo.

Sophie (CS): Draft exec slide done — includes three pricing scenarios (trial credit, month-to-month enterprise price, and 12-mo commit). Sharing link: https://redwood.share/halcyon-exec-1pager (will attach final after Matt's numbers)

Matt (SE): :thumbsup: I'll upload SOC2 pointer + BYOK diagram to the thread and flag any E2E caveats. Also will generate the cost delta table for dedicated vs hosted.

Micah (Legal): I'll prepare the BYOK clause and ask procurement to prioritize. If they insist on custom escrow language we need lead time.

Anna (AE): OK — plan: internal sync at 5:30pm PT today to finalize materials. Customer call 9:00am PT tomorrow. Please bring final numbers + slides. Thanks everyone :pray:
